purpose: Replace the falsified spatial donor-rank transport by a direct train-only query-local residual likelihood while retaining an intact empirical stochastic copula: predict a continuous logistic-mixture marginal at every query voxel, then transform the unchanged paired V31 donor rank at that same voxel without any rank rearrangement.

inherited_inputs.selection_rule: reuse every frozen V28/V31 query, donor identity, donor isometry, and member pairing byte-for-byte

supervised_train_only_channels: V41 full extreme-structure block probability, nearest-neighbor lifted from 16^3 to 64^3
V41 object log10 mean delta squared prediction, broadcast over 64^3
conditioning.channel_standardization: one equal-source train-only voxel mean and standard deviation per channel; constant object channels are weighted one object per source before spatial broadcast

target_and_likelihood.target: physical residual y_truth minus the frozen V14 corrected backbone
target_and_likelihood.target_standardization: one equal-source train-only scalar mean and standard deviation over physical residual voxels
target_and_likelihood.distribution: five-component continuous logistic mixture independently parameterized at every native voxel
parameters: five scales equal softplus(raw_scale)+0.01 standardized residual units
target_and_likelihood.objective: equal-source mean exact continuous logistic-mixture negative log likelihood per voxel

network.upsampling: nearest-neighbor factor two followed by reflection-padded 3x3x3 convolution
network.skip: concatenate encoder feature at matching resolution then one residual block
network.normalization: GroupNorm with eight groups where divisible, otherwise the largest divisor at most eight
network.final_initialization: zero weights and biases, giving equal components at zero location with softplus(0)+0.01 scale before training

training.mixed_precision: CUDA autocast plus GradScaler; mixture log probabilities remain float32
training.augmentation: uniform one of 48 signed cube isometries applied jointly to all conditioning channels and target
training.validation: fixed diagnostic NLL at steps 4000, 8000, and 12000; never used for stopping, selection, or hyperparameter changes

sampling.candidate: compute query-local mixture parameters once, compute the unchanged paired donor V31 conditional-rank field and frozen isometry, and apply the monotone inverse of the local mixture CDF to each rank at the same flat query voxel
sampling.mixture_inverse: solve sum_k weight_k*sigmoid((x-location_k)/scale_k)=u by exactly 28 vectorized bisection iterations between the most conservative componentwise logistic 1e-7 and 1-1e-7 endpoints; this preserves the complete donor rank ordering pointwise
sampling.numerical_rank_bound: clamp only arithmetic u to [1e-7,1-1e-7]; empirical V31 midpoint ranks lie strictly inside this interval and this is not density clipping
sampling.post_sample: undo train-only residual standardization and apply one exact residual DC projection before adding the unchanged query backbone

matched_arms.query_local_mixture_copula: actual query-local mixture parameters and the unchanged paired donor rank field; the only selectable arm
matched_arms.rolled_parameter_control: periodically roll all 15 predicted mixture-parameter fields by (16,8,4) native voxels while keeping the query backbone and donor rank fixed
matched_arms.structure_risk_ablation: rerun query inference with the standardized V41 block-risk channel set identically to zero while retaining every other query channel and donor rank
matched_arms.common: identical query, donor, isometry, V31 rank field, backbone, trained model, sampling arithmetic, and exact DC rule except for the named control change

development_evaluation.primary_pass: query_local_mixture_copula passes field, Q3, and Q4 independently in every domain

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass every domain but any field check fails
high-k power and residual RMS pass every domain but Q3 or Q4 fails anywhere
rolled parameter control equals or improves candidate Q3 and Q4 jointly in every domain

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact V43, V35 data/cache, V31 copula, V41 model, and frozen selection hashes
train-only conditioning and target moments are source balanced and finite
network shape, exact architecture, zero final initialization, parameter count, and finite nonzero gradients
mixture log probability and inverse-sampling analytic self-consistency
one real source-balanced GPU step with peak allocated memory below 24 GiB
one real paired-donor sample is finite, has no rank permutation, and residual DC below 1e-7
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
